description: A compose.yaml that describes services, volumes and their settings so one command starts the whole system.
A command Compose runs at an interval to decide whether a container is healthy, with retries and a start period.
A depends_on condition that starts a service only after the dependency's healthcheck passes.
A named group of services that Compose starts only when the profile is enabled, such as a full profile for the API and client.
The Spring Boot rule that maps an environment variable such as SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL to the property spring.datasource.url.
The spring-boot-docker-compose module that starts the compose file with the application and derives connection details from the containers.
The Compose service name used by another container to reach it on the internal network, independent of host-published ports.
